bait_content.title: I/O Conflict Detected
bait_content.body: Kernel reported repeated timeout retries on NVMe device /dev/nvme0n1. To protect data, write caching has been temporarily degraded and affected volumes may enter read‑only mode. Save your work and review SMART and kernel logs (Disks -> SMART Data & Self‑Tests, or run 'journalctl -k').
